name: abstinence
description: Avoiding something that may have brought pleasure or relief. Successful encounter with temptation.

variations.name: social abstinence
variations.description: May be socially motivated to follow a group's conventions.

variations.name: hesitant abstinence
variations.description: May come with regret if there's still a part that misses the pleasure.

variations.name: satisfied abstinence
variations.description: May come with satisfaction for living up to your own expectations.

commentaries.quote: Abstinence may be a well-practiced habit of self-control with barely any awareness of the avoided pleasure, or it may be an act of terrific willpower.
I pass the test. I will diminish, and go into the West, and remain Galadriel.

conditions: Self conforms to an ideal by avoiding an action with conflicting internal support.
